// diagnostic

E3107

`{operation}` is missing unsafe obligations: `{obligations}`.

What

`{operation}` is missing unsafe obligations: `{obligations}`.

Why

Effective `.Obligations` policy requires a typed proof immediately after each low-level operation.

Fix

add `assert valid_ptr, aligned, no_alias`, reduced to the operation-specific required subset.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3107: tests/ui/unsafe_obligation_missing.stderr.

  6 |         pointer :: *Int.{*value}
    |                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the effective `.Obligations` policy requires a typed proof immediately after each low-level operation
 Fix: add `assert no_alias` immediately after this operation
